name: joey-agent
description: Find live paths to people. Prepare introductions with your agent and exact approval. Record confirmed outcomes and voluntary trust statements with separate consent.

interface.shortDescription: Activate paths to people with Joey.
defaultPrompt: Use $joey to show my paths and the next person to ask.
Use $joey-activate-path to prepare an introduction request for <target>.
Use $joey-path-follow-up to find paths that need a follow-up.
Use $joey-tracker-sync to update path progress from my email and calendar.
Use $joey-attest to record the relationship and trust statements that I choose to share.
Use $joey-trust to show the relationship context and trust support for <person or agent>.
